'A structural change to rafters or trusses triggers a construction permit under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7.' 5:23-2.7 is the ordinary-MAINTENANCE (no-permit) section; it is 5:23-2.7(b) that EXCLUDES structural work from the exemption (which is why a permit is then required). Citing bare 5:23-2.7 as the section that 'triggers a permit' is backwards in surface reading. The sibling asphalt/metal combos cleanly say a structural change 'still triggers a permit' with no section cite.
